verdicts.reason: Both use the same left-to-right banner structure, and both have the same flaws: the 'WEEKEND ONLY' kicker drops below the body copy instead of leading it, the legal line is too small to read (about 6px), the can is small with an illegible label, and the peach circle is cropped behind the button. A keeps a clear margin to the right of 'Shop Sale'. B pushes the button almost flush against the right edge, so it looks cramped, and its can label has lost its text, so B is worse.
